SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 AND f.c>=5 AND f.a<3.0) AS usd_computed,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc_usd>50 AND f.c>=5 AND i.avg_rtg<3.0) AS usd_itemavg,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc/100.0>50 AND f.c>=5 AND f.a<3.0) AS prc_computed,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id WHERE i.prc/100.0>50 AND f.c>=5 AND i.avg_rtg<3.0) AS prc_itemavg;

SELECT 
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f WHERE f.ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM items_g2)) ref_match,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fdbk_g2 f WHERE f.item_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM items_g2)) item_match,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.ref_id) FROM fdbk_g2 f WHERE f.ref_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM items_g2)) ref_items,
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.item_id) FROM fdbk_g2 f WHERE f.item_id IN (SELECT ref_id FROM items_g2)) item_items;
SELECT i.ref_id, i.avg_rtg, f.c, ROUND(f.a,2) fdbk_avg FROM items_g2 i JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g2 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id ORDER BY f.c DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT i.ref_id, i.avg_rtg item_avg, i.rtg_ct item_ct, s.avg_rtg stats_avg, s.review_ct stats_ct, f.c fdbk_ct, ROUND(f.a,3) fdbk_avg
FROM items_g1 i
LEFT JOIN fdbk_stats_g1 s ON s.ref_id=i.ref_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) c, AVG(rtg) a FROM fdbk_g1 GROUP BY ref_id) f ON f.ref_id=i.ref_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(f.c,0) DESC LIMIT 8;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS answer
FROM items_g2 i
JOIN (
  SELECT ref_id, COUNT(*) AS review_ct, AVG(rtg) AS avg_rating
  FROM fdbk_g2
  GROUP BY ref_id
) f ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
WHERE i.prc_usd > 50
  AND f.review_ct >= 5
  AND f.avg_rating < 3.0;
